description: What Form Filler's one window may ask of the app: the folder and save dialogs, and the file plugin's reads and writes. No folder is named here, so none can be reached until it is granted while the app runs: the app's own data folder at the start (src/lib.rs), a folder you pick in a dialog, or one of Form Filler's own names in your home folder (grant_home in src/lib.rs).
